captions.instagram:
The "14-day rule" is real, but it's narrower than social media makes it sound.

✔️ IRS rule: if you use a dwelling as your home and rent it out for fewer than 15 days in the year, you don't report that rental income.
✔️ You also don't deduct rental expenses for those days.
✔️ Renting your home to your own company for meetings is where people get into trouble: the rent has to be fair, the meetings real and documented, and the company type matters.
✔️ Made-up days or inflated rent are a red flag.
